method: resumed run, by eye: per face the picked front and back stand frames, upper half at 4x (sheet px), beside the approved portrait and both at tier H (review/identity-<unit>-<n>.png); the marks are the ones the prompts named (cmd_kits.kit_marks: the face's own weapon and mantle). tick = front view, back = back view (None: not seen from behind). y reads, p partly, n absent. Facing of every back sheet checked on review/facing-<unit>-back.png.
